kind: manual single run, not part of E1/E2
how: docker compose -p cwext -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.external.yml up -d --no-deps server, EXTERNAL_DATASET_PATH=<repo>/data/docs, QUERY_EXPANSION=false, INDEX_THREADS=4
corpus: Project Gutenberg books from the public deepmind-gutenberg bucket, split into ~200 KiB documents by tools/prepare_dataset.py
notes: bind mount from the Windows host, cold file cache, one run; not comparable with E1 which uses a Linux named volume and a warm cache
